name: News
author: Alejandro Llanes
description: A news reader in the bar. Hacker News out of the box, any RSS/Atom feed you add, with article artwork, bookmarks, and a cache you control.

barWidget.description: Headlines from Hacker News and your own feeds

schema.label: Refresh every
schema.description: Minutes between polls. Every source is fetched on the same tick, spaced a couple of seconds apart so a slow server never blocks the others.

schema.label: Keep unread stories for
schema.description: Days. Older stories are dropped on cleanup. Bookmarks are never dropped, whatever their age.

schema.label: Stories kept per source
schema.description: A ceiling per feed, applied newest-first. Bookmarks sit outside the ceiling.

schema.label: Fetch missing artwork
schema.description: When a feed ships no image, read the article page's OpenGraph tags to find one. This contacts the publisher's site; turn it off and only artwork the feed itself provides is used.

schema.label: Show artwork in cards
schema.description: Off gives a dense, text-only list. Artwork already on disk is kept, not deleted.

schema.label: Cache only (no network)
schema.description: A real kill switch. Nothing leaves the machine; the reader keeps working from disk.

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: Headline rotates through unread stories. Count is just the unread number. Icon is the quietest option.

schema.label: Headline rotates every
schema.description: Seconds. Only applies while the bar is in headline mode.

schema.label: Mark read when opened
schema.description: Opening a story in the browser marks it read. Off keeps the unread count under your control alone.
